_readme: Every text the helper's window shows. Edit or translate the values; keep the keys.
A value is one string, or a list of strings shown as separate lines.
{placeholders} are filled in by the helper; keep the ones a text uses.
The window shows 4 lines of text (a long line wraps and takes two).
{files} becomes one line per file, each written with the file_line_* texts; file_updated_suffix
is added to the line of a file a newer upload replaced. {files} gets the lines its text leaves:
2 in waiting and usb_done, 3 in the others. When the files don't fit, it shows the unfinished
files with the most progress, then files_summary; a finished batch shows files_all_done.
The helper reads this file when it starts (restart Orca to see changes).
name_mismatch: "{file}" doesn't end in {ext}, and may not be recognized by the printer.
eject_in_use: The drive is in use ({elapsed}). Close any Explorer window or file open from it.
eject_failed: Close any Explorer window or program using it, then try again.
printing: Follow it on the printer or in Orca's Device tab.
send_failed: Couldn't send to the printer ({done} of {total} sent).
error_no_address: No printer address. Set "printer" in the plugin's settings in Orca.
error_login: The printer rejected the login. Check the password in Orca's printer connection settings.
error_login_unknown: The printer asked for an unknown login: {detail}
error_no_storage: The printer has no writable storage. Is a USB stick plugged into the printer?
error_printer_busy: The printer can't start a print now. It's printing or not ready.
